About ENVLO

Specialist Consultancy

Engineering the building envelope as an integrated system.

ENVLO is a building envelope and façade engineering consultancy focused on the design, performance and long-term value of complex building envelopes.

We support architects, developers, contractors and multidisciplinary design teams from early-stage concept through detailed design, technical coordination and construction.

01

Specialist Expertise

Façade engineering, structural design, building physics and envelope performance.

02

Integrated Thinking

Architecture, structure, material, climate and constructability considered as one coordinated system.

03

Project Delivery

Concept through detailed design, technical coordination and construction.

03

Engineering the envelope as a system

We approach the building envelope as the interface between architecture, structure, climate and material — integrating design, engineering and performance into one coordinated system.

04

What we do

Concept design, system development, façade typologies, material selection, technical design and buildable envelope solutions.

Structural analysis and engineering of façade components, supporting systems, connections and interfaces.

Thermal analysis, condensation risk, thermal bridging, solar performance, daylight and envelope performance studies.

Material efficiency, embodied impact, energy performance, durability, lifecycle thinking and performance-led façade optimisation.

Assessment of existing façades, adaptive reuse, refurbishment strategies, performance upgrades and responsible retention or replacement of existing envelope systems.

Development of façade concepts into coordinated systems, key details, interfaces, specifications and technically resolved solutions.

Coordination of the complete façade package across architecture, structure, building physics, waterproofing, interfaces, specifications, BIM and specialist disciplines.

Façade access strategies, cleaning and maintenance requirements, BMU integration, replacement strategies and coordination with the building envelope.

Façade BIM, technical documentation, model coordination, interdisciplinary interfaces and digital delivery of building-envelope packages.
